description: This source file defines the WebSocketConnectionManager class, which manages WebSocket connections, allowing adding, removing, and broadcasting messages to all active WebSocket clients.

classes.name: WebSocketConnectionManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing WebSocket connections, including adding, removing, and broadcasting messages to connected clients.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all stored WebSocket connections with their identifiers.

methods.name: AddSocket
methods.description: Adds a new WebSocket connection and returns its generated unique identifier.

methods.name: RemoveSocketAsync
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection by its identifier and closes it gracefully.

methods.name: BroadcastAsync
methods.description: Broadcasts a string message to all open WebSocket connections.
